item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 20 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 20 #SLPRSD
Issued at 04:00 PM 02 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Masbate(Placer, Cataingan, Palanas, Dimasalang), #Romblon(Cajidiocan, SanFernando, Magdiwang), #CamarinesSur(Cabusao, Magarao, Canaman, Gainza and Milaor) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #CamarinesSur(DelGallego, Ragay, Lupi, Sipocot, Libmanan, Pasacao, SanFernando, Minalabac, Bula, Balatan, Bato, Pamplona, Nabua), #Albay(Libon), #Masbate(Milagros, Mandaon, Balud, Cawayan, Esperanza and PioV.Corpuz) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
